Evidence-supported failing dependency: checkout's call to oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge is rejected by the payment service ('Payment request failed. Invalid token.'), which surfaces as a gRPC-13 PlaceOrder failure at checkout and, by that path, as the observed HTTP 500 on POST /api/checkout. The gRPC-13→HTTP-500 mapping is an inference from the error spans, not a directly observed access-log row.

Provisional: the payment errors getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND metadata.google.internal / ECONNREFUSED 169.254.169.254:80 occurred earlier in the window (11:53:41Z–11:54:25Z) and target a cloud metadata endpoint; they may be startup/bootstrap lookups incidental to the Charge 'Invalid token' rejections. No telemetry in this run ties them causally to the order failures.

Provisional: the 'app.loyalty.level=gold' substring appears verbatim in both checkout and payment error text, so the rejection may relate to token/loyalty-level dependent validation in payment's charge handler (charge.js). No configuration, injector setting or token value is visible in this run; this remains unverified.

The visible frontend and frontend-proxy data do not show a broad frontend outage: frontend's sampled spans are http.status_code=200 with 0 error spans by listed tags, and the displayed frontend-proxy access rows are 200/308. Only 19 of 126 frontend-proxy hits were displayed, so this does not establish a population success rate.

Rejected: a cart or product-catalog/currency/shipping dependency of checkout as the failing call. checkout's client histogram series for GetCart, GetProduct, Convert and GetQuote are all labelled status 0, and cart logged only Information-level GetCartAsync/AddItemAsync rows in the window (63 backend hits, 20 displayed).

Advisory (not executed): inspect payment's charge handler behaviour around token validation (the error originates at /usr/src/app/charge.js:37 and is returned as gRPC code Unknown), and confirm whether checkout is sending a valid charge token for the affected requests; correlate with a volume metric for POST /api/checkout to bound the failure rate.
